title: Architecture Decision Record
description: JSON Schema for validating Evolith ADR artifacts. Applies to all ADRs in reference/core/architecture/adrs/

status.description: ADR lifecycle status. Proposed ADRs require Architecture Board review before merge.

date.description: Date when the decision was made or proposed. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

owner.description: Accountable owner for this decision (name or role).

scope.description: Scope category: Technology Stack, Architecture Pattern, Security, etc.

satelliteOrigin.description: If promoted from satellite, reference the original satellite ADR ID.

context.description: Decision context, business drivers, architectural pressure, and constraints. Must be substantive.

decisionDrivers.description: List of decision drivers that forced this architectural choice.

optionsConsidered.description: At minimum two options must be documented. Include pros and cons for each.

decision.description: Clear statement of the selected option and the reasoning behind it.

positive.description: Positive outcomes resulting from this decision.

followUpActions.description: Follow-up actions required after this decision. Tracked for compliance.

parentPRD.description: Reference to the parent PRD that authorized this decision.

functionalStory.description: Functional Story ID that triggered this ADR.

technicalStory.description: Technical Story ID tracing implementation back to this decision.

affectedBoundedContext.description: Bounded context(s) affected by this decision.

relatedADRs.description: Array of ADR IDs that are related to or superseded by this decision.

references.description: External references: standards, RFCs, vendor docs.
